projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.benwolf: Blitzwolfer, a Loboan: a werewolf with a werewolf's strength and spring, claws, and senses that miss nothing. His jaw splits into four to fire a sonic howl that knocks everything flat. Hidden: a mistransform finds him.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.benwolf.role: Sonic brawler: claws up close, howls that blast crowds away, and senses that find everything.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.benwolf.passiv: Sonic howls: a cone (G), a beam (Shift+G) and a charged shockwave all round him (hold Z) -- his jaw splits into four to fire them.
Loboan strength and spring: big claws (+7), long leaps (X) and pounces (Shift+R), and falls barely hurt.
Tracking Senses (V): every creature and player within 32 blocks outlined for him, and night vision.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.benwolf.weakne: Sensitive Ears: explosions and sonic booms hurt him half again and leave him reeling.
Charging the Shockwave slows him to a crawl.
Not on the dial until a mistransform (the 11th, 22nd, 33rd...) finds him.
A raking slash in front of you (3.5 blocks, wide): 8.
projecthero.omnitrix.benwolf.pounce.desc: Leap at the creature in the crosshair (16 blocks), or straight ahead. Landing on it hits everything there for 14 and pins it for 1 s.
Your jaw splits into four and you howl: a 14-block cone of sound, 12 to everything in it and thrown back hard.
projecthero.omnitrix.benwolf.focused_how: The howl in one tight beam (24 blocks): 16 to everything on it, knocked back, straight through a crowd.
projecthero.omnitrix.benwolf.howl_shockw: Hold Z to charge (up to 2 s, slowed), let go to howl in every direction: 14 within 4 blocks uncharged, up to 22 within 9 fully charged, thrown back and up. A tap fires it uncharged.
projecthero.omnitrix.benwolf.wolf_leap.d: A long bounding leap where you look. No fall damage until you land.
projecthero.omnitrix.benwolf.frenzy.desc: Six claw slashes in 1.2 s at whatever is in front of you (3 blocks): 5 each, and it is held in the flurry.
projecthero.omnitrix.benwolf.tracking_se: For 15 s you hear and smell everything within 32 blocks: every creature and player is outlined (for you alone), and you see in the dark.
projecthero.omnitrix.benwolf.loboan_stre: A big, springy body: you jump higher, step up blocks and shrug off falls of up to 13 blocks.
projecthero.omnitrix.benwolf.keen_senses: Tracking Senses also gives you night vision while it lasts.
projecthero.omnitrix.benwolf.sensitive_e: Explosions and sonic booms hurt you half again and leave you dizzy and slowed.
